title.zh: 背过的东西为什么会忘，怎样才记得住
title.en: Why We Forget What We Studied, and What Makes It Stick

desc.zh: 遗忘曲线、间隔效应、复习的工作量、考自己和重读的差别、为什么“觉得会了”靠不住。每一章都用已发表的模型或实验数据，标明哪些是模型算的、哪些是实验测的，以及每条结论有多可靠。
desc.en: The forgetting curve, the spacing effect, the cost of a review schedule, testing versus rereading, and why feeling you know it misleads. Every chapter uses a published model or published data, marks what is modelled and what was measured, and says how well each finding holds up.

desc.zh: 艾宾浩斯 1885 年的节省率数据和 2015 年的复现：先快后慢，幂函数比单一指数贴得好得多。
desc.en: Ebbinghaus's 1885 savings data and its 2015 replication: fast then slow, fitted far better by a power function than by a single exponential.

zh: 背过的东西为什么会忘
遗忘是指数还是幂函数
en: why do I forget what I studied

title.zh: 很多条指数的平均是幂函数
title.en: Averaging exponentials gives a power law

desc.zh: 每个记忆按指数衰减、快慢各不同时，平均曲线恰好是 (1 + t/β)^−α，尾巴随差异变平。
desc.en: If each memory decays exponentially at its own rate, the average is exactly (1 + t/β)^−α, with a tail that flattens as the rates spread.

zh: 为什么遗忘曲线尾巴很长
en: why the forgetting curve has a long tail

desc.zh: 同样练四次，分开练比挤在一起好；用 Pavlik 与 Anderson 的 ACT-R 模型和它发表的参数演示。
desc.en: Four practices spread out beat four crammed together, shown with Pavlik and Anderson's ACT-R model and its published parameters.

title.en: The optimal gap between study sessions

desc.zh: Cepeda 等人 2008 年 1,354 人的实验：要记得越久，最优间隔越长，但占记忆期的比例从约四成降到约一成以内。
desc.en: Cepeda et al. 2008, 1,354 people: the longer you need to remember, the longer the best gap, but its share of the retention interval falls from about 40% to under 10%.

desc.zh: 开源调度器 FSRS-6 在记忆快掉到目标保持率时安排复习，间隔因此越拉越长。
desc.en: The open-source FSRS-6 scheduler reviews a card just as it would drop to the target retention, so the gaps keep growing.

zh: 背单词软件怎么安排复习

title.zh: 复习工作量与目标保持率

desc.zh: 每天 20 张新卡片、目标 90%，模型给出第一年末每天约 150 次复习；目标提到 97%，复习量约翻一倍，记住的只多几个百分点。
desc.en: With 20 new cards a day at 90% target, the model gives about 150 reviews a day after a year; at 97% the load roughly doubles for a few more points remembered.

desc.zh: Roediger 与 Karpicke 2006：5 分钟后再读更好，一周后考过的更好；元分析平均 g 约 0.50。
desc.en: Roediger and Karpicke 2006: rereading wins at 5 minutes, testing wins at a week; meta-analytic mean g about 0.50.

title.zh: 学习错觉：觉得会了不等于记住了
title.en: Feeling of knowing versus what you remember

desc.zh: 读四遍的组最有信心、一周后记得最少；多数人认为集中学和间隔学一样好，实际间隔更好。
desc.en: The group that reread four times was most confident and remembered least; most people judge massed study as good as spaced, though spacing did better.

zh: 为什么看懂了却不会做
en: why I feel I know it but can't recall it

title.zh: 学习研究结论的可靠程度
title.en: How robust the learning findings are

desc.zh: 逐条列出各结论的证据、效应量范围和把握程度，区分实测和模型输出。
desc.en: Each finding with its evidence, effect-size range and confidence, separating measurements from model output.

zh: 学习方法有没有科学依据
